target_applications: unmanned pharmacy/retail picking, factory logistics, research

base_type.value: wheeled omnidirectional base + single telescoping/folding leg (lift column)

reach_mm.source: https://www.aparobot.com/robots/galbot-g1 (workspace floor to 2.4m via leg lift; arm span 1.9m)

torso_lift.value: ~650mm telescoping leg stroke; folds for floor-level picking

battery_kwh.source: capacity not disclosed; 54.6V/6A charging per https://chozan.co/galbot-g1/

runtime_h.source: https://www.aparobot.com/robots/galbot-g1 (600 min; 8h continuous per market context)

end_effector.value: parallel 2-finger grippers (deployments); dexterous hand/suction options in demos; wrist depth cameras

sensors_wrist_hand.value: 2x wrist depth cameras; 2x six-axis force/torque sensors

software_stack.value: closed three-tier brain-cerebellum-controller stack ('AstraBrain' per aggregators); GraspVLA grasping foundation model (SynGrasp-1B synthetic data); NL tasking; kiosk fleet cloud; software subscription ~$27k/robot/yr

safety_compliance.value: no published certifications; unmanned-kiosk operating model separates robot from public

price.value: JD.com RMB 690-700k (~USD 97k); flash sale RMB 630k 02/2026; US reseller USD 119,995

availability.value: shipping; China direct + JD.com; limited international reseller stock

deployment_evidence.value: ~170 unmanned kiosk stores/pharmacies in 40+ cities; Haidian pharmacy license 2026-03-12; CATL/Mercedes-Benz China/Zeekr/BYD factory ops; orders 'several thousand units' from CATL, Bosch, Toyota, BAIC, SAIC

notes: Weight (85 vs 92.5kg), DoF (24 vs 47) and runtime (8 vs 10h) conflict across sources; official spec sheet not public. BMW pilot unverified.
